units.source_text: 围棋人士有事同他商量，他也只应声“噢”，就直愣愣地一声不响，因此很难了解他的意见。

en.t: When people from the Go world had matters to discuss with him, he would only answer, "Oh," then stare blankly and say nothing, so it was very hard to understand what he thought.

units.source_text: 对于像名人这样享有崇高地位的人，一般又不好多问。

en.t: With someone of such exalted standing as the Master, people generally found it awkward to press him further.

units.source_text: 我想，这种情况有时也令人相当为难。

en.t: I imagine that situations like this could sometimes be quite troublesome.

units.source_text: 在客人面前，许多时候都是由夫人代表名人招待和酬酢。

en.t: In front of guests, it was often his wife who received them and exchanged courtesies on the Master's behalf.

units.source_text: 名人发呆时，夫人就焦虑不安，替他敷衍周旋。

en.t: When the Master drifted into a daze, his wife would grow anxious and smooth things over for him.
